searchText: A side question in one of the calls this week was around access list utilisation. I pulled out all the mainnet transactions of signature type 1, and had a look. Seems to be ~270k transactions total, accounting for ~5% of all potential gas space. This gist has all the transactions as .csv, a notebook with some simple charts (output stripped for size), and some charts as a comment on the gist https://gist.github.com/perama-v/b9b8c5595f4ce9e3651b816da32d6841 https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/83961755/126026723-a86c88d1-8fe2-4bec-a3d9-75cdcdfb5d73.png I also took that sample in the top right of the chart above. It corresponds to a set of transactions with zero gas fee and >100 access list keys.
